title: NACHO
text: NACHO (NAnoString quality Control dasHbOard) works NanoString nCounter data. nCounter assay measures messenger RNA micro RNA (mRNA/miRNA) expression fluorescent barcodes. barcode assigned mRNA miRNA, counted binds target. count barcode therefore shows much target present. NACHO loads, visualizes normalizes exported nCounter data, helps check quality. shows quality control metrics, expression control genes, principal components sample-specific size factors interactive web application. Two functions summarize visualize RCC files: load_rcc() function preprocesses data. visualise() function starts Shiny-based dashboard relevant QC plots. NACHO also normalise() function. calculates sample-specific size factors normalizes data. normalise() function returns nacho object holds settings, raw counts normalized counts. Since v0.6.0, NACHO two functions: render() function writes full quality control report Quarto, HTML PDF file, result load_rcc() normalise(). autoplot() function draws quality control metrics visualise() render(). information, see vignette("NACHO") articles package website. title: NACHO
text: normalise() normalises nacho object new settings returns new object. default scales samples geometric mean positive controls ("GEO"). "GLM" fits Poisson model positive negative controls instead.
